question: Does a gas-inclusive tensor built from measured ACCEPT electron-density shells and registered Chandra morphology transfer across the four raw cluster lenses?

locked_field.lineage: locked P0557 coupling/operator; no lens score selects the gas construction

gas_map.radial_profile: exact line-of-sight projection of contiguous piecewise-constant ACCEPT electron-density shells; use ne and ne uncertainty only, never Mgrav
gas_map.angular_modulation: Gaussian-smooth point-source-masked Chandra 0.7-2.0 keV rate map, divide by its one-pixel annular mean, raise to q, cap, and renormalize every annulus to mean one

stellar_map.shape: registered background-subtracted, lens-image-masked CLASH F160W light
stellar_map.amplitude: normalize the full 120-arcsec map to the published Tian BCG total stellar mass
stellar_map.limitation: satellite and ICL light in the image are assigned the BCG total; no separate stellar M/L map exists

claim_limits: ACCEPT shell density is measured, but shell covariance is unavailable and only diagonal ne errors are published.
Chandra brightness modulates non-circular shape and is not treated directly as gas mass.
The HST stellar map has one global BCG mass normalization and no resolved M/L, satellite, or ICL mass separation.
The Tian-anchor renormalization is an extreme cross-catalog sensitivity because the raw catalogs disagree by factors of 4-14 at the central anchor.
All systems and t=0.3 are spent; this is a fully specified diagnostic, not independent validation.
No formula can be promoted from P0559.
